### 스텝업(Step-up) 적립식 투자 시뮬레이터

초기 자산과 매월 쌓아가는 적립금, 그리고 소득 증가에 따른 '연간 적립금 증액률'을 반영하여 미래 자산의 복리 성장 곡선을 역산하는 계산기입니다. 예상 연수익률을 복리 월할로 쪼개어 매월 초 입금되는 동적 흐름을 시뮬레이션합니다.

```{=html}
<div class="simulator-control-panel" style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 18px; padding: 1.5rem; margin: 2rem 0; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif;">
  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 1.2rem;">
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">초기 보유 자산 (억 원)</label>
      <input type="number" id="inputInitAsset" value="1" step="0.5" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">초기 월 적립금 (만 원)</label>
      <input type="number" id="inputMonthlyCont" value="100" step="10" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">적립금 연간 증액률 (%)</label>
      <input type="number" id="inputStepUpRate" value="5" step="1" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">예상 연 수익률 (%)</label>
      <input type="number" id="inputAnnualReturn" value="8" step="0.5" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">물가상승률 (0~10%)</label>
      <input type="number" id="inputInflationRate" value="2.5" min="0" max="10" step="0.1" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px;">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.8rem; color:#86868b; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:4px;">투자 기간</label>
      <select id="selectPeriod" style="width:100%; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #d2d2d7; border-radius:8px; background:white;">
        <option value="5">5년</option>
        <option value="10" selected>10년</option>
        <option value="20">20년</option>
        <option value="30">30년</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>
  <button id="btnCalculate" style="width:100%; background:#007aff; color:white; border:none; padding:10px; border-radius:10px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer;">적립식 시뮬레이션 가동</button>
</div>

<div class="chart-container-wrapper" style="display: block; width: 100%; clear: both; margin: 2rem 0;">
  <div id="dcaChart" style="width: 100%; max-width: 850px; height: 450px; margin: 0 auto;"></div>
</div>

<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 2rem auto; max-width: 850px; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif;">
  <div style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.2rem 0.8rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
    <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;">최종 납입 원금 총액</span>
    <span id="kpiTotalPrincipal" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1d1d1f;">Calculating...</span>
  </div>
  <div style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.2rem 0.8rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
    <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;">최종 자산 (명목)</span>
    <span id="kpiFinalEvaluation" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #86868b;">Calculating...</span>
  </div>
  <div style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.2rem 0.8rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
    <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;">최종 자산 (실질 구매력)</span>
    <span id="kpiFinalRealAsset" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #007aff;">Calculating...</span>
  </div>
  <div style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.2rem 0.8rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
    <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;">실질 순수익금</span>
    <span id="kpiNetProfitReal" style="font-family: monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #34c759;">Calculating...</span>
  </div>
</div>

<details style="margin: 2.5rem auto; max-width: 850px; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif;">
  <summary style="cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1d1f; padding: 12px 16px; background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 10px; list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; user-select: none; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">
    <span>📋 연차별 적립 및 복리 정산 내역</span>
    <span style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #86868b; font-weight: 400;">클릭하여 펼치기 ▾</span>
  </summary>
  <div style="overflow-x: auto; margin-top: 1rem; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #e8e8ed;">
    <table class="table" style="width: 100%; min-width: 650px; font-size: 0.88rem; text-align: center; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 0;">
      <thead>
        <tr style="background: #fafafa; border-bottom: 2px solid #1d1d1f; font-weight: 600;">
          <th style="padding: 12px 4px; width: 15%;">연차</th>
          <th style="padding: 12px 4px; width: 25%;">당해 월 적립금</th>
          <th style="padding: 12px 4px; width: 25%;">누적 납입 원금</th>
          <th style="padding: 12px 4px; width: 35%;">잔액 (물가 반영 전 / 실질 가치)</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody id="dcaTableBody">
        </tbody>
    </table>
  </div>
</details>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const btnCalculate = document.getElementById('btnCalculate');

    function runDCASimulation() {
      if (typeof Plotly === 'undefined') { setTimeout(runDCASimulation, 200); return; }

      let initAsset = (parseFloat(document.getElementById('inputInitAsset').value) || 0) * 100000000;
      let initialMonthlyCont = (parseFloat(document.getElementById('inputMonthlyCont').value) || 0) * 10000;
      let stepUpRate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('inputStepUpRate').value) || 0;
      let annualReturn = parseFloat(document.getElementById('inputAnnualReturn').value) || 0;
      let inflationRate = parseFloat(document.getElementById('inputInflationRate').value) || 0;
      let periodYears = parseInt(document.getElementById('selectPeriod').value) || 10;

      let monthlyReturn = Math.pow(1 + (annualReturn / 100), 1 / 12) - 1;
      let totalMonths = periodYears * 12;

      let currentAsset = initAsset;
      let cumPrincipal = initAsset; 
      let currentMonthlyCont = initialMonthlyCont;

      let xYears = ['0년 (초기)'];
      let yPrincipalChart = [Math.round(initAsset / 1000000) / 100];
      let yAssetChart = [Math.round(initAsset / 1000000) / 100];
      let yRealChart = [Math.round(initAsset / 1000000) / 100]; // 실질 가치 트래킹 라인 생성
      let tableHtml = "";

      for (let m = 1; m <= totalMonths; m++) {
        if (m > 1 && (m - 1) % 12 === 0) {
          currentMonthlyCont = currentMonthlyCont * (1 + (stepUpRate / 100));
        }

        currentAsset += currentMonthlyCont;
        cumPrincipal += currentMonthlyCont;
        currentAsset = currentAsset * (1 + monthlyReturn);

        if (m % 12 === 0) {
          let currentYear = m / 12;
          
          // 🚨 [물가 역산 배관] 연말 시점의 누적 복리 디스ка운트 팩터 도출
          let inflationFactor = Math.pow(1 + (inflationRate / 100), currentYear);
          let realAssetValue = currentAsset / inflationFactor;

          xYears.push(`${currentYear}년`);
          yPrincipalChart.push(Math.round(cumPrincipal / 1000000) / 100);
          yAssetChart.push(Math.round(currentAsset / 1000000) / 100);
          yRealChart.push(Math.round(realAssetValue / 1000000) / 100);

          tableHtml += `
            <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed;">
              <td style="padding: 12px 4px; font-weight:500;">${currentYear}년차</td>
              <td style="padding: 12px 4px; color:#86868b;">₩${Math.round(currentMonthlyCont).toLocaleString()}</td>
              <td style="padding: 12px 4px; font-family:monospace;">₩${Math.round(cumPrincipal).toLocaleString()}</td>
              <td style="padding: 12px 4px; text-align:left; padding-left:8%; font-family:monospace;">
                <span style="color:#86868b;">반영 전:</span> ₩${Math.round(currentAsset).toLocaleString()}<br>
                <span style="color:#007aff; font-weight:600;">실질:</span> ₩${Math.round(realAssetValue).toLocaleString()}
              </td>
            </tr>
          `;
        }
      }

      document.getElementById('dcaTableBody').innerHTML = tableHtml;

      // KPI 대시보드 정산 연산
      let finalInflationFactor = Math.pow(1 + (inflationRate / 100), periodYears);
      let finalRealAsset = currentAsset / finalInflationFactor;
      let netProfitReal = finalRealAsset - cumPrincipal;

      document.getElementById('kpiTotalPrincipal').innerText = '₩' + Math.round(cumPrincipal).toLocaleString();
      document.getElementById('kpiFinalEvaluation').innerText = '₩' + Math.round(currentAsset).toLocaleString();
      document.getElementById('kpiFinalRealAsset').innerText = '₩' + Math.round(finalRealAsset).toLocaleString();
      
      const profitCard = document.getElementById('kpiNetProfitReal');
      profitCard.innerText = '₩' + Math.round(netProfitReal).toLocaleString();
      profitCard.style.color = netProfitReal >= 0 ? '#34c759' : '#ff2d55';

      // Plotly 시각화 엔진 동기화 (3선 차트 포메이션)
      let tracePrincipal = {
        x: xYears, y: yPrincipalChart, name: '누적 납입 원금', type: 'scatter', mode: 'lines',
        line: { color: '#8e8e93', width: 2, dash: 'dash' },
        hovertemplate: '<b>%{x}</b><br>누적 원금: %{y}억 원<br><extra></extra>'
      };
      let traceAsset = {
        x: xYears, y: yAssetChart, name: '자산 가치 (명목)', type: 'scatter', mode: 'lines+markers',
        line: { color: '#aeaeb2', width: 2 }, marker: { size: 4 },
        hovertemplate: '<b>%{x}</b><br>명목 가치: %{y}억 원<br><extra></extra>'
      };
      let traceReal = {
        x: xYears, y: yRealChart, name: '실질 구매력 (물가 반영)', type: 'scatter', mode: 'lines+markers',
        line: { color: '#007aff', width: 3 }, marker: { size: 5 },
        hovertemplate: '<b>%{x}</b><br>실질 가치: %{y}억 원<br><extra></extra>'
      };

      let layout = {
        title: { text: '<b>적립식 복리 투자 자산 성장 곡선 (물가 변동 반영)</b>', font: { size: 15, family: '-apple-system, sans-serif' } },
        plot_bgcolor: '#f5f5f7', paper_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
        xaxis: { tickfont: { size: 10 }, gridcolor: '#e8e8ed' },
        yaxis: { title: '자산 가치 (억 원)', tickfont: { size: 11 }, gridcolor: '#e8e8ed', ticksuffix: '억' },
        legend: { orientation: 'h', x: 0.5, xanchor: 'center', y: -0.18 },
        margin: { t: 50, b: 80, l: 65, r: 20 }
      };

      Plotly.newPlot('dcaChart', [tracePrincipal, traceAsset, traceReal], layout, {responsive: true, displayModeBar: false});
    }

    if (btnCalculate) {
      btnCalculate.addEventListener('click', runDCASimulation);
    }
    runDCASimulation();
  });
</script>

<div class="simulation-docs-callout" style="background: #f5f5f7; border-radius: 14px; padding: 1.5rem; margin: 3rem auto 2rem auto; max-width: 850px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.03); font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif;">
  <h4 style="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: #1d1d1f; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;">
    <span>📌</span> 적립식 연산 매커니즘 가이드
  </h4>
  <ul style="list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem;">
    <li style="margin: 0; padding-left: 0;">
      <strong style="color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 0.9rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 2px;">1. 예상 연수익률의 복리 월할 분할</strong>
      <span style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #424245; line-height: 1.5;">기하평균 공식에 의거해 연수익률을 정밀한 월할 복리율로 역산하여 복리 왜곡 현상을 원천 방어합니다.</span>
    </li>
    <li style="margin: 0; padding-left: 0;">
      <strong style="color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 0.9rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 2px;">2. 월초 선제 적립 및 소득 증액 복리 결착</strong>
      <span style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #424245; line-height: 1.5;">매월 초 월 적립금이 선제 계정에 투입되어 당월 복리 성장을 온전히 반영하며, 설정된 연간 증액률(Step-up) 룰셋은 매 12개월마다 월 적립금 규모를 우상향 보정합니다.</span>
    </li>
    <li style="margin: 0; padding-left: 0;">
      <strong style="color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 0.9rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 2px;">3. 누적 물가상승률 기반 실질 구매력 역산</strong>
      <span style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #424245; line-height: 1.5;">설정된 물가상승률을 기반으로 매년 자산 잔액의 실제 화폐가치를 역산합니다. 명목 금액의 복리 증식 착시를 소각하고 최종 실질 구매력의 도달 범위를 정량 계측합니다.</span>
    </li>
  </ul>

  <div style="margin-top: 1.5rem; padding-top: 1.2rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06); font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.6;">
    <strong style="color: #1d1d1f; display: block; margin-bottom: 8px;">📊 테이블 항목 범례</strong>
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px;">
      <div><strong style="color: #86868b;">• 반영 전:</strong> <span style="color: #424245;">물가 상승률이 반영되지 않은 자산의 명목 평가 금액</span></div>
      <div><strong style="color: #007aff;">• 실질:</strong> <span style="color: #424245;">물가 상승률(화폐가치 하락)이 감안된 현 시점 기준의 실제 구매력 가치</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
